_readme: This is a REFERENCE document, not an auto-import file — as of this writing, Retell's
dashboard requires each custom function to be added manually (Agent > Tools > + Add >
Custom Function). Use the fields below to fill in each one. Replace
https://your-app.vercel.app with your actual deployed domain everywhere it appears.
For every function: set Method = POST, and set 'Payload: args only' = ON in the Retell
dashboard so the JSON body is just the arguments (these endpoints also work if it's OFF,
since they check for an 'args' wrapper either way — but ON matches the parameter shapes
Every request to these URLs must carry a valid X-Retell-Signature header — Retell adds
this automatically. The endpoints reject anything else with 401.

functions.name: verify_client
functions.description: Verifies a caller's identity/account before disclosing any order details. Call this before checking order status, and before discussing anything about an existing order.

phone_number.description: Caller's phone number, as spoken or from caller ID.

facility_name.description: Facility or account name the caller gives, if any.

account_number.description: Account number the caller gives, if any.

functions.name: validate_address
functions.description: Validates a street address before it is used for pickup or delivery. Call once for the pickup address and once for the delivery address.

address.description: Full street address including city, state, and zip if given.

functions.name: calculate_route
functions.description: Gets a rough estimated time window between a validated pickup and delivery address. Share the result only as an estimate, never a guaranteed time.

functions.name: create_pending_order
functions.description: Submits a new pickup order for dispatcher review. Only call this after reading the full order summary back to the caller and receiving an explicit yes — caller_confirmed must be true.

caller_confirmed.description: Must be true — only set after the caller explicitly confirms the read-back summary.

facility_name.description: The client/account facility name (step 1 of intake).

delivery_contact_email.description: Optional — caller often won't have this handy; dispatcher can add it on review.

ready_time.description: When the package will be ready for pickup, as the caller describes it.

delivery_deadline.description: Required delivery deadline, as the caller describes it.

functions.name: get_order_status
functions.description: Looks up an existing order after the caller has been verified. Only share status, driver first name, estimated times, pickup/delivery confirmation, and proof-of-delivery status — nothing else.

order_id.description: Order ID or reference number, if the caller has it.

caller_phone.description: Used as a fallback lookup if no order ID is given.

functions.name: cancel_order
functions.description: Cancels an order that has not yet been picked up. Only use for a straightforward cancellation — for any other change, use request_human_transfer instead.

functions.name: request_human_transfer
functions.description: Transfers the call to a human dispatcher. Call this immediately, without trying to resolve the situation yourself, whenever the transfer conditions in the system prompt are met.

context.description: One sentence of context for the dispatcher picking up.

functions._note: This endpoint only LOGS the transfer request for dispatcher follow-up. The actual live phone transfer is a separate Retell dashboard feature — pair this custom function with Retell's built-in 'Transfer Call' node/action and point it at your dispatcher's real phone number, so the call itself actually moves, not just the log entry.

env_vars_required.RETELL_API_KEY: From Retell dashboard > API Keys. Must be a key with the 'webhook' badge — used to verify the X-Retell-Signature header on every request above.
env_vars_required.ADMIN_API_KEY: A secret you choose. Protects /api/admin/clients, used to register verified client accounts (phone, facility name, account number) that verify_client checks against.
